response.overview: Improve Manufacturing Operations with a Reliable ERP System  Modern manufacturing companies need accurate production planning, inventory control and real-time business information to stay competitive. A reliable ERP for manufacturing helps businesses connect their production, purchasing, inventory, sales and accounting activities within one organised system.  Introduction  Managing a manufacturing company through separate spreadsheets and disconnected software can create stock errors, production delays and incorrect costing. A well-configured manufacturing ERP system provides one central platform where business owners and managers can monitor materials, manufacturing orders, work centres, product costs and delivery schedules.
